name: USO Peeling Width Does Not Increase under pc-Minors
statement: If $C'$ is a pc-minor of an ample class $C$, then $\nu(C')\le\nu(C)$. More precisely, conditioning restricts a representation orientation to an induced subgraph, while the canonical in-map orientation on a projection has no larger strongly connected component.
proof: Restriction cannot enlarge a strongly connected component. For a projection, lift every projected vertex to the sink of its coordinate fiber. Each projected arc lifts to a directed path between the chosen representatives; therefore a strongly connected component downstairs injects into one strongly connected component upstairs. Iterate the two inequalities along the pc-minor sequence and minimize over orientations.
